perks.desc:
Optimized for fast reloading.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Greatly increases reload speed

perks.name: Ricochet Rounds
perks.desc:
Rounds ricochet off hard surfaces. 
  •  Increases stability 
  •  Slightly increases range

perks.name: Light Mag
perks.desc:
Improved reload and range.
  •  Increases reload speed
  •  Slightly increases range

perks.desc:
Rounds cause extra damage to combatants' shields and overpenetrate targets. 
  •  Slightly increases range

perks.name: Drop Mag

perks.name: Assault Mag
perks.desc:
This shotgun's magazine is optimized for quick combat.
  •  Greatly increases stability
  •  Increases rate of fire

perks.name: High-Caliber Rounds
perks.desc:
Shots from this weapon knock the target back farther.
  •  Slightly increases range

perks.name: Under-Over
perks.desc: Deals bonus damage to targets with overshields. Deals a small amount of bonus damage to combatant shields.

perks.name: Outlaw
perks.desc: Precision kills greatly decrease reload time.

perks.name: Rangefinder
perks.desc: Aiming this weapon increases its effective range and zoom magnification. Increased projectile velocity while aiming Rocket Launchers, Grenade Launchers, and Bows.

perks.name: Shot Swap
perks.desc: Final blows build and store charges which allow you to swap and stow this weapon at a faster rate.

perks.name: Perfect Float
perks.desc: Being in combat for a moderate time increases airborne effectiveness and reduces flinch until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Slickdraw
perks.desc: Significantly increases handling, significantly decreases target acquisition.

perks.name: Killing Wind
perks.desc: Final blows grant increased mobility, weapon range, and handling for a short duration.

perks.name: Slideshot
perks.desc: Sliding partially reloads this weapon's magazine and temporarily boosts range and stability.

perks.name: Lone Wolf
perks.desc: Slightly improves aim assist, aim down sights speed, and airborne effectiveness. Increases these effects when there are no nearby allies.

perks.name: Destabilizing Rounds
perks.desc: Defeating a target creates a Void burst; hitting other targets with this burst makes them volatile and grants you Volatile Rounds for a short duration.

perks.name: Moving Target
perks.desc: Increased movement speed and target acquisition when moving while aiming down sights.

perks.name: Withering Gaze
perks.desc: Aiming this weapon for a short period of time without firing grants the ability to weaken the next target. Timer resets after firing or when you stop aiming down sights.

perks.name: Keep Away
perks.desc: Increases reload, range, and accuracy when no targets are in close proximity.

perks.name: Rapid Hit
perks.desc: Rapid precision hits temporarily increase stability and reload speed.

perks.name: Zen Moment
perks.desc: Causing damage with this weapon reduces recoil and flinch over time.

perks.name: Gutshot Straight
perks.desc: Aiming down sights increases body shot damage, decreases target acquisition.

perks.name: Repulsor Brace
perks.desc: Defeating a Void-debuffed target grants an overshield.

perks.name: Rampage
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon temporarily grant increased damage. Stacks 3x.

perks.name: Multikill Clip
perks.desc: Reloading grants increased damage based on the number of rapid final blows made beforehand.

perks.name: Encore
perks.desc: Final blows grant a stacking stability, range, and accuracy bonus to this weapon. Precision final blows grant more stacks.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.desc: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Eye of the Storm
perks.desc: This weapon becomes more accurate and boosts handling as your health gets lower.

perks.name: Opening Shot
perks.desc: Improved accuracy and range on the opening shot of attack.

perks.name: Precision Instrument
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage increases precision damage.

perks.name: Magnificent Howl
perks.desc: The number of precision final blows before reloading affects the total rounds granted with increased range and damage. Precision final blows with Magnificent Howl active extend the effect for additional rounds.

perks.name: Demoralize
perks.desc: Precision final blows cause nearby targets to become weakened.

perks.name: Sword Logic
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. The strength and duration of the bonus increases when more powerful targets are defeated.

perks.name: Kill Clip
perks.desc: Reloading after a kill grants increased damage.

perks.name: One for All
perks.desc: Hitting three separate targets increases damage for a moderate duration.

perks.name: Alacrity
perks.desc: Gain increased reload, stability, aim assist, and range when an ally is defeated. Bonus increases when multiple allies are dead at the same time or when you are running solo.

perks.name: One Quiet Moment
perks.desc: Grants increased reload speed and handling when out of combat. Swords gain faster movement speed.

perks.name: Suros Synergy
perks.desc: Reloading grants this weapon bonus handling and reduces incoming flinch for a short time.

perks.name: Fleet Footed
perks.desc: Dealing damage grants you a short window of increased movement speed and airborne effectiveness. Landing a final blow increases these effects.

perks.name: Roar of Battle
perks.desc: Being in combat for a short duration increases handling and stability.

notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 133 from 11 March 2025 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/49VFDRj05iDXTJDOBqQpga?si=e61731a19fb64938) with @CourtProjects, @Saint_Kabr and @ImpetusAlways (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick for use against Minor add groups in both general at-level or better, and end-game underlevelled content, particularly with void builds. Exalted Truth returns with a perk refresh and provides quite a convincing argument for popping into Trials to get some useful PvE rolls. At base, the stats are good by comparison with its peers - 50 Range and 14 Zoom equate to 30.75m ADS and 20.50m hipfire, 58 Stability is ×1.1641 flinch resist at 100 Resilience, 55 Handling is 0.32s ready, 0.24s ADS and 0.35s stow speed, 47 Reload Speed is a 2.61s reload, Recoil Direction is 95, and base magazine size is 11 (max 14). Use the barrel perk to improve Handling, and then the magazine perk can round out Reload Speed and/or bump up magazine size. For void builds, Destabilizing Rounds is in the first trait perk column, spreading volatility and proccing volatile rounds for clearing add crowds which you can combine in the second column with Repulsor Brace for a void overshield, or Demoralize to provide an effective ×1.18 damage boost to nearby enemies by spreading void weaken. The reworked Skulking Wolf origin trait can be useful in PvE, making enemies less accurate when firing at you for 10s after getting a kill while at low health, or if you're soloing content, Alacrity provides excellent gunfeel boosts: +20 to Range and Stability, +50 to Reload Speed and +10 to Aim Assist. Recommended MW: Handling with a Backup Mag mod or, when fully enhanced, Synergy to create Void Breaches or, when the artifact mod's around, Stunloader. Also, don't forget to check whether there's a useful Seasonal Fragile mod for the activity you're running.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "The Trials version of Palindrome. They feel slightly different between the two. Withering Gaze and Demoralize, Repulsor Brace and Destabilizing Rounds. Take your pick. All will work well together." Recommended MW: Reload Speed.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "Exalted Truth is a better Palindrome depending on what you're looking for. Slideshot and Zen Moment are both incredible. Lone Wolf or Keep Away are also great in slot. There's only bad options if you want a strictly PvP roll instead of both PvP and PvE. Eye of the Storm will allow for some much needed forgiveness as the gunfight goes on. Opening Shot will all but guarantee your first shot is a crit. And Magnificent Howl will allow for two taps." Recommended MW: Range.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): Recommended MW: Reload. Adaptive(140) Void Hand Cannon Primary Ammo. "Exalted Truth has few perks going for it in PvE. Outlaw and Repulsor Brace are good on void builds but fall off immediately on anything else. Frenzy is good for neutral damage and Multikill Clip is best used where you can one-shot most enemies and is overkill at best."

pandapaxxy (PvP / Controller): Recommended MW: Range. Adaptive(140) Void Hand Cannon Primary Ammo. "Exalted Truth’s place is in the crucible. Funny how that works, yeah? Rangefinder and Eye of the storm are best in slot and you already knew that. I don’t need to say much more."

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB): Recommended MW: Range. Adaptive(140) Void Hand Cannon Primary Ammo. "Exalted Truth’s place is in the crucible. Funny how that works, yeah? Rangefinder and Eye of the storm are best in slot and you already knew that. I don’t need to say much more."

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "This is going to be Palindrome-lite. It won’t have the same all-encompassing perk pool that made Palindrome so good in all aspects of the game. But being a void hand cannon that can take adept mods, has frenzy and alacrity can come in handy when in GMs or master content. While it’s not a direct 1:1 it can fill a hole if you missed Palindrome before it was taken from the loot pool." Recommended MW - Reload.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB): "Similarly, Exalted Truth will be the direct comparison in PvP [to Palindrome]. Rangefinder in the third column paired with eye of the storm will make Exalted Truth a very coveted hand cannon. This combo only rolls on a select few hand cannons. Cantata-57, Ancient Gospel, Austringer, Bottom Dollar, and now Exalted Truth. Having access to adept mods puts Exalted Truth at the top of this family and alacrity is just the cherry on top. Keep an eye out for this hand cannon come Trials." Recommended MW - Range.
